purpose: THE SINGLE INDIRECTION POINT for review items R1, R2, R4 and R6.

Neither egfr-source.v1.shex nor egfr-target.v1.shex contains a domain class IRI, a person IRI or a quality IRI. Every one of them is a ThreadedMaterializer staticVar named here. A reviewer answer is an edit to this file; the schemas are untouched.

Each entry records where its value comes from and which review item governs it. An entry sourced from a policy table is a mirror of that table, not a second opinion: tests/contracts/maps/test_indirection_point.py asserts they agree.

qualityBranch.source: DR-002 axiom 6; REVIEW-REQUEST R4 option A
qualityBranch.note: sulo:Feature is a disjoint union of Capability/InformationObject/Quality/Role, so the concept note's literal 'a sulo:Feature' leaves the individual unpartitioned. Defaulting to option A, which the reviewer has not confirmed.

personSuloClass.note: sulo:Feature owl:disjointWith sulo:SpatialObject. Bare sulo:Object is the weaker, safe choice: it cannot create the disjointness clash that sulo:SpatialObject would if any Feature branch were ever also asserted of a person. The reviewer decides.

person.note: Concept note section 4: supplied as a run binding, never extractable from the FHIR RDF. No map may hard-code it and none does: grep the two .shex files for the string 'person'.

quality.note: The quality identity policy mode is deliberately unset and rejects every request until the reviewer answers R2. Answering it moves every quality IRI; it moves no other IRI in this map.

unitIri.note: UCUM mL/min/{1.73_m2}. A unit IRI is shared across observations by design; a per-observation blank node would duplicate it and break Gate 4 idempotence.

node_key_note: CD-1: the pinned engine has no id(), so these are host-chosen ROOT NODES, not engine-minted IRIs, and they are declared in MapContract.node_key_rules rather than computed by a Map function.

Keyed by resource id, NOT by version: a correction (a new meta.versionId) recomputes the same node IRIs and replaces their triples, which is what concept note section 7 asks for. The version appears in prov:wasDerivedFrom.

GAP reported to the integration lead: Agent 5's identity service mints person and quality IRIs but not result / record / time node IRIs. These three rules are currently owned here. They should move behind the identity service so a single component owns node identity.
pass_vars_note: Every name in a pass's `vars` that is not source-bound is supplied as a staticVar for that pass and for no other. tests/contracts/maps/test_egfr_gate2.py asserts lastReport.unusedStatics == [] on every pass, so this list cannot drift from the schema without a test failure. That assertion is the CD-1 substitute for the static checker the engine does not ship.
